newsitem.title: CROATIA: IB Austria Croatia becomes bourse member.
newsitem.headline: IB Austria Croatia becomes bourse member.

text.p: IB Austria Croatia said on Tuesday it had gained membership of the Zagreb bourse after obtaining a brokerage licence from the securities commission.
"We are now members of both the Zagreb Stock Exchange and Varazdin (OTC) market," Ratko Bajakic, director of the Croatian investment arm of Austria's leading bank, told Reuters.
He said the local unit, which now has an eight-strong staff with two licensed share traders on board, would start normal operations next week.
Apart from securities trading, it also aims to take an active part in the privatisation process, particularly the forthcoming mass privatisation through vouchers.
IB Austria is also awaiting legislation on the establishing and operating of investment funds that the market watchdog has been preparing for some time.
It plans to employ more people in Croatia soon and might double total staff by the end of this year, Bajakic said. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
